name: io.github.caiovicentino/x402check
title: x402check
description: Risk-check counterparties before an AI agent pays; pay x402 resources only after a verified allow

environmentVariables.name: X402CHECK_CREDIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid credit token (x402c_…, from POST https://x402check.xyz/v1/credits): $0.001 a check

environmentVariables.name: X402CHECK_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated low-balance wallet: pays the x402 resources x402check_pay clears, and per-call checks without credits

environmentVariables.name: X402CHECK_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap for this server process: the payer's spend (checks and resources), and separately what checks spend from prepaid credits

environmentVariables.name: X402CHECK_PINNED_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated RFC 7638 thumbprints of the attestation keys accepted (default: x402check's own keys, for its own issuer)

environmentVariables.name: X402CHECK_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: The most a single payment may cost (a check or a resource)
